skill.name: sent-account-readiness
skill.description: Checks the authorized Sent account, organization and Sender Profile scope, balance, onboarding/KYC status, and readiness with the Sent MCP tools. Use when a user asks whether the account can send, what the MCP connection authorized, whether funds are sufficient, why onboarding is blocked, or for a preflight check before a mutation or channel launch. Route remediation to the relevant onboarding or compliance skill.
skill.summary: Checks Sent account scope, balance, onboarding status, and messaging readiness without changing account state.
skill.author: sentdm

content.value_statement: Messaging launches can fail when account scope, balance, or onboarding status is unclear. This skill checks those conditions through authorized Sent MCP tools.
actual_capabilities: Identifies the authorized Sent account, organization, and selected Sender Profile.
Checks the account balance before high-volume messaging.
Reports onboarding or KYC status as incomplete, pending, approved, or blocked.
Summarizes messaging readiness and identifies observed blockers.
Routes remediation needs to the relevant onboarding or compliance skill.
limitations: Requires an authorized Sent MCP connection for live account data.
Does not change onboarding, compliance, billing, or Sender Profile state.
Cannot verify readiness when authentication fails or MCP is unavailable.
Reports available status data but does not guarantee channel approval or message delivery.

use_cases.title: Preflight a Messaging Launch
use_cases.description: Check account scope, balance, and onboarding blockers before scheduling a messaging campaign.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Onboarding Delays
use_cases.description: Identify the current onboarding status and route unresolved requirements to the correct specialist skill.

use_cases.title: Verify Authorized Scope
use_cases.description: Confirm which organization and Sender Profile the current MCP authorization permits.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Readiness Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether my authorized Sent account is ready to send messages. Summarize any blockers.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before a routine messaging task.

prompt_templates.title: Balance Preflight
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my Sent balance for a planned high-volume send. Include the currency and available freshness information.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when funding may block a campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Onboarding Diagnosis
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Sent onboarding status. Separate observed status from recommended remediation and name the relevant specialist skill.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when onboarding or KYC progress is unclear.

prompt_templates.title: Full Channel Launch Assessment
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess account scope, Sender Profile, balance, and onboarding readiness for my planned channel launch. Mask identifiers and prioritize blockers.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a comprehensive launch review.

output_examples.input: Is my Sent account ready to send?
output_examples.output: The authorized account is active, onboarding is approved, and no readiness blocker was reported. The selected Sender Profile is masked for privacy.

output_examples.input: Can I run a high-volume messaging campaign today?
output: Account scope: authorized for the selected organization and Sender Profile.
Balance: available in USD, with freshness information included.
Readiness: review campaign funding before launch.

output_examples.output: Onboarding is blocked at the reported compliance step. The skill preserves this observed status and routes remediation to the relevant compliance workflow.

best_practices: Authorize through the MCP client and never provide credentials in chat.
Run a fresh readiness check shortly before a high-volume send or channel launch.
Share only the minimum account details needed and mask identifiers when practical.
anti_patterns: Do not paste tokens, API keys, authorization headers, client IDs, or secrets.
Do not treat an observed onboarding status as proof that remediation is complete.
Do not use this skill to mutate onboarding, billing, or compliance state.

faq.question: What does this skill check?
faq.answer: It checks authorized account scope, Sender Profile, balance, onboarding status, and messaging readiness.

faq.question: Does it require Sent authorization?
faq.answer: Yes. Live checks require OAuth authorization through a compatible MCP client.

faq.question: Should I paste my API key?
faq.answer: No. Never provide tokens, API keys, authorization headers, client IDs, or other secrets.

faq.question: Can it fix blocked onboarding?
faq.answer: No. It diagnoses status and routes remediation to a relevant onboarding or compliance skill.

faq.question: Can it change the authorized organization?
faq.answer: No. Reauthorize through the MCP client to select a different organization or Sender Profile.

faq.question: Does a ready result guarantee message delivery?
faq.answer: No. Readiness reflects available account data and does not guarantee channel approval or delivery.
